title: BlockRules Misc
description: Replaces and modifies blocks based on a series of rules

rules.title: Rules
rules.description:
List of block rules evaluated on all blocks of a Structure Template. Block rules are evaluated in order. If a block rule succeeds and the output_state is set, the output_state block will be used as the input_predicate block for subsequent rules.

Properties:
• block_entity_modifier (object)
• input_predicate (object)
• location_predicate (object)
• output_state (object)
• position_predicate (object)

defaultSnippets.label: Processor Rule Misc
defaultSnippets.description: A block rule that is evaluated on all blocks of a Structure Template. All predicates must evaluate to true in order for a block to be replaced by the output_state.

misc_processor_rule.title: Processor Rule Misc
misc_processor_rule.description: A block rule that is evaluated on all blocks of a Structure Template. All predicates must evaluate to true in order for a block to be replaced by the output_state.

block_entity_modifier.title: Block Entity Modifier
block_entity_modifier.description: A block state modifier for block entities when all predicate match.

input_predicate.title: Input Predicate
input_predicate.description: A predicate evaluated on the Structure Template block.

location_predicate.title: Location Predicate
location_predicate.description: A predicate evaluated on the world block.

output_state.title: Output State
output_state.description: Block to replace the world block with if all predicates evaluate to true.

position_predicate.title: Position Predicate
position_predicate.description: A predicate evaluated on the distance between the structure's world origin and the world block.
